posts.title: Textrusive
posts.description: What do you feel? When your heart suddenly stops. And your breaths aren't enough. The time has now, slowed down. Tried ignoring you, I can't somehow. What would you say? When she's only just a text far. And you're afraid of her scars. The poet's eyes, is where things hide. A glass hearted romance, as she writes. The worst that can happen? posts.title: Being a Scientist
posts.description: The first time you do so it's science. The second time it's engineering. The third time it's just being a technician. I'm a scientist. Once I do something, I want to do something else. - Clifford Stoll You might be wondering how I know that you're awesome! Because I know you read this via RSS.
